issues.t: Timing chain guide breaks and rattles
issues.sym: A rattling or 'marbles in a can' noise from the top front of the engine, often louder at idle or start-up.
issues.why: The plastic upper timing chain guide on the 2.4L engine can crack or come apart and rub on the chain. Broken pieces can fall into the oil pan and block the oil pickup.
issues.next: Do not ignore it. Have the valve cover removed to inspect the guide. If the chain or tensioner is worn, replace them through the front cover before oil pressure or the cam timing is affected.

issues.t: Distributor failure causes rough idle or no-start
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires that get worse when hot, hard starting, stalling, or a whining noise from the distributor.
issues.why: The distributor contains the ignition parts and the crank and cam sensor. With age its internal parts wear out.
issues.next: Have the ignition system tested while the problem is happening. A new or rebuilt distributor is the usual fix; also check the knock sensor and spark plugs, which can cause similar symptoms.

issues.t: Valve cover gasket and spark plug well oil leaks
issues.sym: A burning oil smell, oil on the outside of the engine, or misfires caused by oil pooling around the spark plugs.
issues.why: The valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals harden with age and let oil seep out.
issues.next: Replace the gasket and plug tube seals together. Clean any oil out of the spark plug wells and check the plugs.

issues.t: Fuel tank leaks and gas smell
issues.sym: A strong gasoline smell around the car, drips under the rear, or a wet spot on the driveway.
issues.why: Owners report the fuel tank splitting at a seam or leaking from the top of the tank.
issues.next: A fuel leak is a fire risk. Do not park in a closed garage, avoid sparks, and have the tank inspected and replaced right away.

issues.t: Brake pedal sinks or brakes fail from a leaking master cylinder
issues.sym: The brake pedal goes soft or sinks to the floor, the brakes grab or lock with a loud noise, or the brake warning light comes on.
issues.why: Owners report the brake master cylinder leaking fluid inside or out, so the brakes lose pressure.
issues.next: Stop driving and have the car towed if the pedal sinks. Check the fluid level and have the master cylinder and brake lines inspected.

issues.t: Parking brake does not hold on a hill
issues.sym: The car creeps or rolls when parked on a slope with the parking brake set.
issues.why: The parking brake works through the rear brakes and cables. Stretched cables or worn rear parts weaken it.
issues.next: Have the parking brake adjusted and the rear brakes checked. Until then, turn the wheels toward the curb and leave it in Park or in gear.

issues.t: Airbags may not deploy or may go off unexpectedly
issues.sym: Owners report airbags that did not deploy in serious frontal crashes, and one case of both front airbags deploying during a low-speed turn.
issues.why: Faults in the crash sensors or airbag module can stop the airbags from working correctly.
issues.next: If the airbag light flashes or stays on, have the system scanned right away. After any deployment, the dash and module must be inspected.

issues.t: Weak A/C from a cracked low-pressure hose
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm or only slightly cool air, often after slowly losing refrigerant.
issues.why: Nissan issued a bulletin for a cracked A/C low-pressure hose on these cars.
issues.next: Have the system leak-tested and the hose replaced before recharging it.

issues.t: Check engine light for evaporative system codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with evaporative emission (EVAP) codes. The car drives normally.
issues.why: Nissan bulletins cover EVAP codes on cars built before a certain point, and also insect nests blocking the EVAP system.
issues.next: Make sure the gas cap is tight first. If the light stays on, ask a shop to check the Nissan bulletins and the EVAP vent lines.

issues.t: Check engine light for airflow sensor code P0100
issues.sym: The check engine light is on with code P0100. The engine may hesitate or idle poorly.
issues.why: Nissan issued bulletins about the mass airflow sensor code being stored on these cars.
issues.next: Have the sensor and wiring tested before replacing parts.

issues.t: Check engine light for misfire code P0300
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on or flashes with code P0300, sometimes with a rough idle.
issues.why: Nissan issued a bulletin for random misfire codes on these cars.
issues.next: A flashing light means a severe misfire. Ease off and have the plugs, wires and distributor checked soon.

issues.sym: A loud exhaust, ticking or puffing sound under the car, or exhaust smell.
issues.why: Nissan issued a bulletin for the front exhaust tube cracking.
issues.next: Have the exhaust inspected. A leak near the front of the car can let fumes into the cabin.

issues.t: Seat belt latch slides down the belt
issues.sym: The front seat belt tongue slides down to the floor when the belt is unbuckled, making it hard to reach.
issues.why: The small stopper button that holds the latch plate in place on the belt can be missing. Nissan issued bulletins on it.
issues.next: Have a stopper button fitted and make sure the belt buckles and retracts properly.

issues.t: Rust in the strut towers, rails and spare tire well
issues.sym: Bubbling paint, holes under the spare tire, rust at the strut towers or around the hatch, or water inside the trunk.
issues.why: These cars are now old, and water and road salt attack the body and underbody. Many have also been modified or crashed.
issues.next: Have the body and frame rails checked on a lift. Structural rust near the strut towers or rails can make the car unsafe.

issues.t: Engine surges at stops with the A/C on
issues.sym: With the A/C on, the engine speeds up and the car pushes forward as you come to a stop.
issues.why: The idle speed rises to carry the A/C load. A dirty or faulty idle control system can overshoot.
issues.next: Hold the brake firmly and have the idle air control valve and throttle body cleaned and checked.
